title: A quarter of Nvidia’s business next year comes from labs it is financing
summary: Nvidia has put nearly US$50 billion into the AI labs that buy its chips, and has lined up commitments for more than $500 billion Colette Kress, the company’s chief financial officer, told analysts on August 26 that demand from the labs Nvidia backs with its own balance sheet will contribute toward roughly a quarter of its business […] The post A quarter of Nvidia’s business next year comes from labs it is financing appeared first on AI News .
